_meta.description: World's-largest, kitsch, and roadside oddities along the Grand Junction → Titusville corridor.
_meta.source: Roadside America + local knowledge, geocoded manually

entries.name: Dinosaur Journey Museum
entries.blurb: Animatronic dinos; roar-worthy first stop out of Grand Junction.

entries.name: Eisenhower Tunnel Overlook
entries.blurb: Highest vehicular tunnel in the U.S. — kitschy bragging rights.

entries.name: Genesee Park Buffalo Herd
entries.blurb: Free-roaming bison visible from I-70 — Denver's edge.

entries.name: World's Largest Prairie Dog
entries.blurb: 8,000-pound concrete prairie dog at Prairie Dog Town.

entries.name: World's Largest Ball of Sisal Twine
entries.blurb: Frank Stoeber's ball — visitors are invited to add a wrap.

entries.name: World's Largest Czech Egg
entries.blurb: 20-foot hand-painted kraslice egg honoring the Czech capital of Kansas.

entries.name: Strataca - Kansas Underground Salt Museum
entries.blurb: 650 feet down into a working salt mine. Genuinely awesome.

entries.name: Cosmosphere
entries.blurb: Smithsonian-affiliate space museum with real Apollo and Vostok hardware.

entries.name: Big Brutus
entries.blurb: 16-story electric shovel — second-largest in the world.

entries.name: Truckhenge
entries.blurb: Half-buried trucks standing on end, by farmer-artist Ron Lessman.

entries.name: City of Fountains
entries.blurb: 200+ fountains; the J.C. Nichols at the Plaza is the iconic one.

entries.name: World's Largest Rocking Chair (Casey, IL)
entries.blurb: Casey, IL is a town of world's-largest things — chair, mailbox, wind chime, pitchfork.

entries.name: Superman Statue
entries.blurb: 15-foot bronze Man of Steel in the official Hometown of Superman.

entries.name: House on the Rock
entries.blurb: Off-corridor detour but legendary kitsch — the Infinity Room and Carousel.

entries.name: The Big Duck
entries.blurb: Roadside-Americana stop on the way east — check the Christmas Story House too.

entries.name: Drake Well Museum
entries.blurb: Birthplace of the modern oil industry — required stop in Titusville.

entries.name: Oil Creek State Park
entries.blurb: Bike/hike along the historic oil boom valley.

entries.name: Randyland
entries.blurb: Hyper-colorful folk-art courtyard on the North Side.

entries.name: Bicycle Heaven Museum
entries.blurb: World's largest bike museum + shop, free to wander.
